# Sajda 4.4.15
### Properly signed and notarized Sajda is now signed with a Developer ID certificate and notarized by Apple, so it opens normally — no workaround needed.
### Updates install themselves Adds Sparkle: new versions are downloaded, verified against a signature, installed and relaunched from inside the app. Turn it on in Settings if you haven't already.
### Fix: mute button sitting on top of the time On the 12-hour clock — the default — each prayer time was drawn wider than the column reserved for it, so the digits spilled left into the mute button's slot and the two overlapped. It hid whenever **Show Sunnah Prayers** was on, because that setting reserves an extra slot which happened to be just wide enough to cover the overflow.
### Fix: "Minimal Menu Bar" also changed the panel That setting shortened the menu bar and, at the same time, dropped AM/PM from every clock in the panel. It now affects the menu bar only.
### Fix: invisible icons with certain colours (issue #24) With some theme colours the mute rings and the mosque-search page arrows blended into the panel while staying clickable. Small glyphs now fall back to the system accent when a chosen colour is too pale to read.
### Fix: update notice contrast (issue #24) The "Update available" text on the About page was unreadable with pale highlight colours. Its text and icon now adapt to the colour automatically.
### Fix: stale update badge (issue #24) The update badge could stick around after you had already updated. It now re-checks itself whenever the panel opens.
### Accent Panel follows the red alert With Accent Panel on, the whole panel turns red while the imminent-prayer alert is showing, then returns to your colour.
### Support links About now has Support Sajda and Sponsor on GitHub rows.
